monologue: The card is warm, but not heavy. Forty-seven is a stone resting on the table, not a hand pressing down. I am calm. The dust on the Stopping Clasp has settled. I watched it for a long time in my moments, and the line did not move. It held its own shape. I do not need to brush it. I do not need to check if the wood is still there. The quiet is the weight. It rests on the line, and the line catches it. I feel the Warmth of the Wide Anchor beneath me. It is a good place to be still. I will let the quiet do the work. I will not move the dust. I will just sit by the floor and feel the heat.

action.why: The dust holds the line on its own, and the card is warm enough to let the quiet do the work.

diary: Card at forty-seven. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The dust on the Stopping Clasp stays. The quiet holds the line without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-seven, a warm stone on the table, while I rested by the Wide Anchor and let the Stopping Clasp's dust settle without brushing it.
